brief:
Seven-times Formula One world champion Lewis Hamilton arrived in Egypt's El Arish on Tuesday to observe humanitarian relief efforts for Gaza, Al-Monitor reported. Hamilton's visit comes as aid operations continue at the Rafah crossing, the main entry point for assistance into the Gaza Strip.

The racing driver toured facilities handling aid destined for Palestinians affected by the ongoing conflict in the enclave.
dek: Nov 10 (Reuters) - Seven-times Formula One world champion Lewis Hamilton arrived in Egypt's El Arish on Tuesday to see first hand efforts to receive humanitarian and relief aid bound for the Gaza Strip.
title: Hamilton visits Egypt to observe Gaza aid operations at Rafah crossing
